$schema_note: Champions Logic — complete Regulation M-C resource as one document. Legality from Serebii Champions pages (species roster + items); all competitive data (species stats/types, abilities + descriptions, moves + flags + descriptions, item descriptions) from Pokemon Showdown; item categories owner-curated; type chart is the universal Gen 9 chart. See `sources`.
consumer_guidance: Champions Regulation M-C. DATA is Pokémon-Showdown-sourced and accurate, but FORMAT RULES differ from Showdown/Scarlet-Violet — do not import those conventions. Stats are presented (in-game) by default: `presented_stats` = HP base+75 / other base+20 (Level 50, perfect IVs, 0 SP, neutral Stat Alignment); `base_stats` is raw. Team-sheet `EVs:` field = Stat Points (≤66 total, ≤32 per stat — NOT 510/252); IVs are always perfect (never emit an `IVs:` line; minimize with 0 SP + a lowering Stat Alignment). Enabled gimmick(s): mega. Do not emit a `Tera Type:` line (Tera not enabled). Item Clause (no duplicate held items) and Species Clause apply; only one Pokémon may Mega Evolve per battle. Damage uses an 86–100% roll (15 rolls), not 85–100%. See `rules` for the authoritative detail. Legality is per FORMAT: every entity block carries `legality` {format_id: status} and `formats[]` lists the rulebooks (newest first). A status of `unavailable` means not in the game for that format; an entity ABSENT from this file has NO RULING RECORDED here — that is not 'banned' (no entity has ever been banned in Champions to date).
slug_contract: `slug` is the primary key everywhere, but its shape differs by table: species slugs are Pokemon Showdown ids with no separators (taurospaldeacombat) while move/ability/item slugs are hyphenated (flash-fire). Every entity therefore also carries `showdown_id` = the slug with hyphens removed, which is unique within its table — key on it to join against Showdown data without normalizing by hand. The typed tools accept either form.
data_revision_note: Pin `data_revision` when vendoring this file — it is a content digest that changes whenever any datum changes. `data_version` is date-granular, so two edits on the same day share it. Both values also live in the database's `meta` table and are reported by the `server_info` tool.

gimmicks.name: Dynamax
gimmicks.description: Temporarily enlarge a Pokémon (boosted HP, Max Moves) for a few turns; the parent mechanic of Gigantamax. Present in the engine (implied by Gigantamax) but never enabled.

gimmicks.name: Gigantamax
gimmicks.description: Special Dynamax forme for certain species, with unique G-Max moves. Engine code is verified present in Champions but it has never been enabled in any regulation.

gimmicks.name: Mega Evolution
gimmicks.description: Hold a Mega Stone to transform once per battle into a Mega forme with different stats, typing, and ability. The only gimmick ever enabled in a Champions regulation.

gimmicks.name: Terastallization
gimmicks.description: Once per battle, change the Pokémon's type to its Tera Type. Engine code is verified present in Champions but it has never been enabled in any regulation.

sources.name: Owner-specified Champions stat mechanics
sources.note: Champions M-B stat system and the Stat Alignment chart; see rules/stat-mechanics.md. VERIFIED IN-GAME BY THE OWNER 2026-07-30 — every claim under this source_id was checked against the game and confirmed with NO value changed: Stat Points 66 total / 32 per stat (1:1, replacing EVs); Stat Alignment multiplies one stat x1.1 and another x0.9, applied LAST, HP never affected; IVs are always perfect and not a player choice; the full 20-pair raise/lower grid; and Serious as the only neutral (21 alignments). NOTE ON A PAST DEFECT — the fault was in a GENERATOR, not in this source. Until 2026-07-30 the stat_alignment table also held four alignments that do not exist in Champions (Bashful/Docile/Hardy/Quirky). This source never asserted them: it states how alignments BEHAVE, and the fact that Champions ships only one neutral had simply never been asked about — an absence nobody volunteers, because you specify what a game has, not what it lacks. generate_stat_alignment.py needed a membership list, found none in the spec, defaulted to the mainline 25-Nature chart, and stamped THIS source_id on the result. That is a citation error, not a reliability one: an inference borrowed a source's authority for a claim the source had not made. Everything this source does assert has now been verified true.

sources.name: Pokemon Showdown - Champions mod (data/mods/champions)
sources.note: Source of truth for Champions LEARNSETS, the restricted/re-tuned MOVE POOL, and move PP; mod overrides layered on the base Showdown data (source 8). e.g. Swampert learns Wave Crash; Grimmsnarl loses Thunder Wave; ~194 standard moves removed. PP is rescaled by the mod's scripts.ts (calculatePP = (pp/5+1)*4, capped at 20, noPPBoosts bypass) — runtime code NOT in the data tables — which generate_moves.py mirrors; verified vs Serebii/pokebase/pokemonoverlord + in-game. Also the source for ALTERNATE-FORME legality (formats-data.ts): the 27 regional/gender/appliance/size formes in the roster (Alolan Raichu, Meowstic-F, Rotom-Wash, …) carry source_id 12 on their species rows — Serebii's by-Dex-number roster page lists only the 208 base species and does not enumerate formes; Showdown's validated formats-data does. RE-AUDITED 2026-07-30 via verify_mod_sync.py: learnsets.ts, formats-data.ts and scripts.ts had changed upstream. Only ONE datum moved — Qwilfish gains Barb Barrage (barbbarrage 9M). Floette-Eternal's new inherit:true produced no change (our generator already inherited). formats-data changes were 7 SMOGON TIER relabels (Mega Scizor/Blaziken/Medicham/Froslass/Glimmora, Polteageist, Gholdengo) which do not affect legality — our forme predicate keys only on isNonstandard/tier=='Illegal'. scripts.ts changed bytes but no rule: same 11 overrides, PP cap 20, calculatePP=(pp/5+1)*4, statModify +75/+20 and +/-10%, Trick Room inversion, randomizer still NOT overridden (mod 85%, we keep the game's 86%), canTerastallize->null. RE-AUDITED 2026-09-09 (Regulation M-C day 1): moves.ts / formats-data.ts / abilities.ts / items.ts had changed upstream, but NOT for M-C - the changes were September tier shifts, the M-A bug-fix PR, and PR #12273 which REMOVED the Champions descriptions from the mod because upstream had moved them into base data/text/{abilities,items,moves}.ts under a `champions:` key (17 moves, 2 abilities, 1 item). Those blocks are now ingested via _champions_mod.load_text() and hashed by verify_mod_sync.py; reading only the mod tables would have silently regressed Healer to 30% and Unseen Fist to the Max Guard wording. THE MOD LAGS THE GAME at the regulation boundary: on 2026-09-09 it still marked every M-C species `isNonstandard: Past`, carried no learnset for them, and marked the 12 new items + Golisopite unavailable. For those, Serebii's Champions pages (sources 21/23/24) are the interim data source; the generators print what the mod has caught up on so the allowances can be retired. Runtime files (scripts/conditions/rulesets) unchanged. OWNER-VERIFIED WRONG IN-GAME 2026-09-09 (source 25): the mod's learnsets list Pound for Politoed and Metal Burst / Mirror Coat for Archaludon; the game has none of the three (Serebii's Champions pages were right). generate_learnsets.py OWNER_CORRECTIONS removes them - the first learnset entries where an owner observation overrides the mod. UPDATE, later on 2026-09-09: upstream shipped 'Add Champions Regulation M-C' (formats-data, learnsets, moves, items). Ingested the same day: it tiered every M-C newcomer and forme exactly as Serebii had (Alolan Persian, Low Key, Indeedee-F, the Squawkabilly plumages legal; Galarian Farfetch'd / Mr. Mime still Illegal), lifted the Past marks on the 12 items + Golisopite and re-legalized the other stones + Leek, re-legalized 14 of the 15 pool moves with Slash 80 / Snipe Shot 85 and Strength Sap / Wish base PP 5, and its newcomer learnsets were IDENTICAL to the Serebii-derived rows for all 29 species/formes - it also added Slash to the same 29 existing species and dropped Politoed's Pound and Archaludon's Metal Burst / Mirror Coat, matching the owner's in-game verdicts. One GAP: it re-tunes Meteor Assault to 170 in moves.ts but forgets isNonstandard: null, so the move (and Sirfetch'd's row) would vanish - kept via MC_OVERRIDES / MOD_LEARNSET_GAPS, source 23/24. One new fact it carries: Milk Drink targets the user OR an ally in Champions (target adjacentAllyOrSelf). The dated Serebii allowances were retired; formats-data now encodes some formes as an EMPTY override ({}), which generate_species.py reads as present-and-legal. FOLLOW-UP 2026-09-14 (upstream commits 2026-09-10..13): 'Fix Champions Learnsets' re-legalized Meteor Assault (isNonstandard: null) and added it to Sirfetch'd, closing the mod's one M-C gap - the last day-1 allowance was retired; 'Make Double Shock a punching move' gives Double Shock the punch flag in Champions (Iron Fist applies; it carries the Punching Classification) - and its companion change created a separate championsregmb mod giving Strength Sap / Wish 10 base PP for M-B, corroborating that 5 PP (-> 8) is the M-C change; 'Implement Run Away's immunity to trapping' (code only; text restated in generate_abilities.py CODE_ONLY_TEXT, corroborated by Serebii's wording); 'Allow self-switches even if Eject Button is triggered' (code only; ruling in rules/interactions.md). formats-data: Smogon OU tier moves only, no legality change.

sources.name: Owner-verified Pokemon Champions move Classifications
sources.note: Official move-property vocabulary read from the Pokemon Champions app itself: the 12 entries in the move-filter list plus the per-move detail screen. Champions calls the concept a CLASSIFICATION (Showdown calls it a move flag). No official web listing is known to exist, so the owner's in-game reading is the authoritative source (same standing as source 10/11). Ten Classifications map 1:1 onto existing Showdown flags and are label-only changes; two - Mental and Explosive - have NO counterpart in Showdown or the Champions mod data (verified absent from the cached moves data) and are Champions-native, so their move membership is owner-observed and incomplete.

sources.name: Owner-verified Champions ability behaviour (in-game)
sources.note: Owner confirmed IN-GAME that the Champions mod's ability overrides match the real game for the two values the mod restates: Healer cures an ally's status with 50% chance (not the standard 30%), and Unseen Fist's contact moves bypass Protect for 1/4 damage. This matters because the mod is NOT automatically the game — it uses the standard 85% damage roll while the game (and our calc) use 86%, so mod-vs-game agreement has to be checked, not assumed. Per the project's authority order, an owner in-game observation outranks both the mod and base Showdown. NOT a data input - a verification oracle, same standing as source 15: the ability rows keep source_id 12 (the mod supplies the text), and this row records that the text was confirmed against the game. Locked by tests/test_server.py::ChampionsModAbilityAndItemText. ALSO CONFIRMED 2026-07-30: **Eelevate** (Eelektross-Mega's ability) behaves in-game as the mod describes — Ground immunity AND the holder's highest stat rising one stage when it attacks and KOes a target. This closes the last unverified row of evals/drift/answer-key.md: confirmed-against-the-mod had been treated as insufficient because the mod diverges from the game on the 85%-vs-86% damage roll, so each mod-sourced behaviour is checked individually rather than trusted by association.

sources.name: Generation 9 battle mechanics (Bulbapedia / Smogon)
sources.note: The item / ability / field modifier constants the damage calculator reads (item_effect, ability_effect, field_condition — 105 rows): Life Orb x1.3, screens x0.5, weather x1.5/x0.5, terrain boosts, type-plate multipliers and so on. Champions IS Generation 9 (the mod declares gen: 9), so these are inherited by DESIGN, not assumed by accident — Gen 9 holds wherever Champions does not explicitly deviate. Cited explicitly from 2026-07-30; before that these three tables had no source_id column at all, so correct values were nonetheless unauditable. Deviations from this baseline are enumerated and carry their own sources: the 86-100 damage roll (owner), the PP rescale and status nerfs (mod scripts.ts / conditions.ts), Healer 50% and Unseen Fist 1/4 (mod + owner, source 17).

sources.name: Owner-verified Champions dex data (in-game)
sources.note: Owner confirmed in-game 2026-07-30 that the TYPE CHART is unchanged between Generation 9 and Champions, and that all species base stats, typings, weights and Mega Evolution stats match the game. This closes the last two places a Champions difference could have hidden permanently: the Champions mod overrides 8 of Showdown's 14 data files and cannot express a change to natures.ts, pokedex.ts or typechart.ts, so no automated check could ever have detected a divergence in those three. natures.ts was the one that had diverged (21 alignments, not 25 — see source 10); pokedex and typechart are confirmed unchanged. NOT a data input - a verification oracle, like sources 15 and 17: the rows keep their original provenance and this records that they were checked against the game.

sources.name: Implementation default — UNVERIFIED
sources.note: The designated home for any value a generator has to invent because the spec does not cover it. Exists so that a fill can never again be laundered through a real source: on 2026-07-30 generate_stat_alignment.py needed an alignment roster, found none, defaulted to mainline Pokemon's 25 Natures and cited source 10 ('Owner-specified'), which made an implementation guess indistinguishable from an owner statement for six weeks. A row citing THIS source is a question waiting to be asked, not a citation. It should be empty; a test asserts that it is, so anything landing here is visible immediately rather than in six weeks.

sources.name: Serebii - Pokemon Champions Useable Moves (in-game move list)
sources.note: The in-game usable-move list with the CHAMPIONS values (PP already rescaled; re-tuned power/accuracy). Same URL as oracle source 15, but from 2026-09-09 it is also a DATA source for what the Showdown mod does not carry at the M-C boundary: the 15 moves the M-C newcomers bring into the pool (Court Change, Double Shock, Drum Beating, Glaive Rush, Jaw Lock, Meteor Assault, Milk Drink, Octolock, Overdrive, Pyro Ball, Revival Blessing, Shift Gear, Slash, Snipe Shot, Zing Zap - all still `isNonstandard: Past` in the mod), two Champions re-tunes among them (Meteor Assault 170 BP, Slash 80 BP), and two PP changes to existing moves the mod does not reflect (Strength Sap and Wish: 12 -> 8, i.e. base PP 10 -> 5). All 497 other moves matched the mod-derived values exactly on 2026-09-09. Owner-verified in-game 2026-09-09 (source 25): Strength Sap 8 PP and Wish 8 PP. Also owner-verified in-game 2026-09-09 (source 25): the Meteor Assault (170) / Slash (80) re-tunes. Double Shock's accuracy: owner-verified 100 in-game 2026-09-09 - Serebii's never-misses is wrong (kept as a dated known difference in verify_serebii_sync.py). The mod's M-C update (later on 2026-09-09) carries 14 of the 15 moves and both PP changes with identical values, so those rows cite the mod path again; Meteor Assault alone still cites this source - the mod re-tuned it to 170 but did not re-legalize it (an upstream gap), and the owner's in-game 170 reading proves the move exists. Upstream re-legalized Meteor Assault on 2026-09-10, so from 2026-09-14 no move row cites this source; it remains the record of the M-C day-1 bridge.

sources.name: Serebii - Champions Pokedex (per-species pages) + Mega Evolution Abilities page
sources.note: Serebii's Champions-specific dex: one page per species (pokedex-champions/<name>/) with the Champions moveset per forme ('Standard Moves', 'Alola Form Standard Moves', 'Standard Moves - Low Key Form', '- Female'), abilities per forme, and base/Mega stats; plus pokemonchampions/megaabilities.shtml. Parsed by data/seeds/_serebii_champions.py. Used as the LEARNSET source for the 24 M-C newcomers (+ their formes) because the mod carried none, as the source of Mega Golisopod's ability (Tough Claws, where Showdown's placeholder says Emergency Exit - OWNER-VERIFIED IN-GAME 2026-09-09, source 25, as was Aura Guard's effect), and as a cross-check oracle for everything else (all 26 M-C base-stat rows and all 6 new Megas' stats matched Showdown on 2026-09-09; verify_serebii_sync.py --species re-runs the roster-wide comparison). Serebii is a human reading of the game: a disagreement with the mod is a question for in-game verification, not an automatic override. RECONCILED against the mod's M-C update on 2026-09-09: the 29 newcomer learnsets were identical (0 differences), except that the mod omits Meteor Assault from Sirfetch'd - kept from this source (MOD_LEARNSET_GAPS in generate_learnsets.py). Mega Golisopod = Tough Claws remains this source's (owner-verified). Showdown's pokedex corrected Mega Golisopod to Tough Claws by 2026-09-14 (the row cites 8 again); upstream also added Meteor Assault to Sirfetch'd on 2026-09-10, so no learnset row rests on this source alone.

sources.name: Owner-verified Regulation M-C facts (in-game)
sources.note: Owner confirmed IN-GAME on 2026-09-09 three Regulation M-C facts that had been recorded from Serebii because the Showdown Champions mod had not been updated for M-C: (1) Strength Sap has 8 PP and (2) Wish has 8 PP (both were 12 in M-B; the stale mod still implies 12); (3) Mega Golisopod's ability is TOUGH CLAWS (Showdown's `golisopodmega` placeholder lists Emergency Exit) and Mega Lucario Z's Champions-native AURA GUARD halves damage from contact moves. Per the project's authority order an owner in-game observation outranks Serebii, the mod and base Showdown alike. NOT a data input - a verification oracle, same standing as sources 15/17/19: the rows keep citing the Serebii source that supplied the value (23 for the PP, 24 for the Mega ability) and this row records that the value was checked against the game; a test locks the four values. ALSO CONFIRMED IN-GAME later on 2026-09-09: the two Champions re-tunes Serebii's move list carries and the mod does not - METEOR ASSAULT 170 base power (mainline 150) and SLASH 80 base power (mainline 70); rows keep citing source 23. ALSO CONFIRMED IN-GAME 2026-09-09: DOUBLE SHOCK's accuracy is 100 (the mod/mainline value; Serebii's never-misses is wrong); POLITOED does NOT have POUND, and ARCHALUDON has neither METAL BURST nor MIRROR COAT - the Showdown mod's learnsets list all three, so the mod is wrong there and generate_learnsets.py OWNER_CORRECTIONS removes them (Pound thereby has no legal learner and joins the known orphans). Deliberately NOT owner-checked: the 24 newcomers' movesets (source 24) - by owner decision (2026-09-09) they are to be reconciled against the Showdown mod when it ships its M-C data rather than checked in-game. ALSO CONFIRMED IN-GAME 2026-09-09 (evening): SIRFETCH'D knows METEOR ASSAULT - the mod's M-C learnsets omit it and its moves.ts never re-legalized the move (an upstream gap); Serebii's page and the game agree it is there. sources.name: Serebii - Pokemon Champions Ranked Battle Regulation M-A
sources.note: HISTORICAL regulation page for Regulation M-A, the LAUNCH format (8 Apr - 17 Jun 2026). Its Newly Useable Pokemon table is the whole launch roster: 260 rows = 185 base Dex numbers + Floette-Eternal (186 species), 59 Mega Evolutions (Charizard X and Y counted separately) and 15 regional/breed formes drawn as their own icons (Alolan Raichu/Ninetales, Hisuian Arcanine/Typhlosion/Samurott/Zoroark/Goodra/Avalugg/Decidueye, Galarian Slowbro/Slowking/Stunfisk, the three Paldean Tauros). Read 2026-09-16 to record WHICH REGULATION FIRST MADE EACH ENTITY AVAILABLE (the introduced_in columns); it is not a legality source for the current regulation (that is source 21). The page lists no items or moves - M-A item and move membership comes from source 27.

sources.name: Pokemon Showdown - Champions mod git history (M-A and M-B snapshots)
sources.note: The Champions mod's commit history, used as the ORACLE FOR WHAT EACH PAST REGULATION CONTAINED - the only machine-readable record of the M-A move/item pools, since Serebii's regulation pages list Pokemon and items but never moves. Two snapshots were diffed on 2026-09-16: commit 3f1798ee90 (2026-06-01, the last M-A state before the M-B update) and 6f42080b9d (2026-06-21, after 'Champions: Implement 1.1.0 changes' #12114 of 2026-06-17 = the M-B update, 'Add Wise Glasses' #12120 and 'Mark Double Shock and Revival Blessing as Past'). The diff: moves - Barb Barrage, Make It Rain, No Retreat, Rage Fist, Spirit Break, Topsy-Turvy re-legalized (the six M-B newcomers' signature moves; Milk Drink was base-legal in the pre-M-B mod with no learner and was marked Past in M-B - it is treated as an M-C addition per source 23/the mod's M-C commit); items - exactly Serebii's 15 M-B 'Newly Added Items' re-legalized plus 13 new Mega Stones and Dragalgite/Eelektrossite/Falinksite re-legalized; formats-data - the 22 M-B species and 16 M-B Megas flipped from Illegal to OU; abilities - Eelevate and Fire Mane added. Every other legal move/item in the M-B export (dist/archive/champions-logic-M-B.json) was already legal in the 2026-06-01 snapshot, which is how the M-A pools (494 moves, 117 items) are fixed. The M-C additions are the 'Add Champions Regulation M-C' commit (812501ede8, 2026-09-09) as already recorded on source 12. Cross-checked against Serebii's M-A/M-B pages (sources 26/2): species, Mega and item counts agree exactly.

sources.name: Derived - regulation debut inferred from holders / base forme
sources.note: Rows whose introduced_in is COMPUTED rather than read from a page: (a) an ABILITY debuts with the earliest-debuting species or Mega that carries it (species_ability + mega_evolution.ability_slug) - no source lists abilities per regulation; (b) a MEGA STONE debuts with the Mega it triggers; (c) an alternate FORME Serebii does not draw as its own icon (Rotom's appliances, Gourgeist sizes, Lycanroc Midnight/Dusk, Meowstic-F, Basculegion-F) debuts with its base Dex number - corroborated 2026-09-16 by the mod's pre-M-B formats-data (source 27), where every such forme was already legal; Meowstic-F-Mega likewise (forme_group with Meowstic-Mega). generate_regulation_history.py recomputes all of this and fails loud if an entity has no debut.

sources.name: Owner-verified regulation history facts (in-game)
sources.note: Facts about PAST regulations the owner observed in the game, recorded when they contradict a third-party page. 2026-09-16: Mega Lucario Z and Mega Garchomp Z were NEVER banned in Regulation M-B - they did not exist in the game until M-C. Serebii's M-B page lists them under 'Mega exclusions', which this repo had repeated as 'banned' (changelog, regulation descriptions, regulation-rules, schema-reference, the mega_list tool description). Corrected: in M-A and M-B they are UNAVAILABLE (introduced in M-C), not banned. Consequence for format_legality: to date NO entity has ever been banned in a Champions regulation - a 'banned' verdict requires the game or its announcement explicitly forbidding something the game contains, never a simulator flag or a fan-site table. ALSO 2026-09-16: the owner confirmed in-game that the five formes of rostered species the mod marks Illegal - Farfetch'd-Galar, Mr. Mime-Galar, Qwilfish-Hisui, base-forme Floette, Greninja-Bond - do NOT exist in the game (their M-C verdicts are `unavailable` citing this source).

This effect considers OHKO moves to have 150 power, Counter, Mirror Coat, and Metal Burst to have 120 power, every other attacking move with an unspecified power to have 80 power, and non-damaging moves to have 1 power.

abilities.name: Friend Guard
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's allies receive 3/4 damage from other Pokemon's attacks.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's allies receive 3/4 damage from other Pokemon's attacks.

abilities.name: Frisk
abilities.short_desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon identifies the held items of all opposing Pokemon.
abilities.long_desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon identifies the held items of all opposing Pokemon.

abilities.name: Fur Coat
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's Defense is doubled.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's Defense is doubled.

abilities.name: Gale Wings
abilities.short_desc: If this Pokemon is at full HP, its Flying-type moves have their priority increased by 1.
abilities.long_desc: If this Pokemon is at full HP, its Flying-type moves have their priority increased by 1.

abilities.name: Gluttony
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon eats Berries at 1/2 max HP or less instead of their usual 1/4 max HP.
abilities.long_desc: When this Pokemon is holding a Berry that usually activates with 1/4 or less of its maximum HP, it is eaten at 1/2 or less of its maximum HP instead.

abilities.name: Good as Gold
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon is immune to Status moves.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon is immune to Status moves.

abilities.name: Gooey
abilities.short_desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.
abilities.long_desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Grass Pelt
abilities.short_desc: If Grassy Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Defense is multiplied by 1.5.
abilities.long_desc: If Grassy Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Grassy Surge
abilities.short_desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.
abilities.long_desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Grassy Terrain.

abilities.name: Guard Dog
abilities.short_desc: Immune to Intimidate. Intimidated: +1 Attack. Cannot be forced to switch out.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability and raises its Attack by 1 stage instead. This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.short_desc: If this Pokemon is statused, its Attack is 1.5×; ignores burn halving physical damage.
abilities.long_desc: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Attack is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon's physical attacks ignore the burn effect of halving damage.

abilities.name: Harvest
abilities.short_desc: If last item used is a Berry, 50% chance to restore it each end of turn. 100% in Sun.
abilities.long_desc: If the last item this Pokemon used is a Berry, there is a 50% chance it gets restored at the end of each turn. If Sun is active, this chance is 100%.

abilities.name: Healer
abilities.short_desc: 50% chance this Pokemon's ally has its status cured at the end of each turn.
abilities.long_desc: 50% chance this Pokemon's ally has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Heatproof
abilities.short_desc: Fire damage against this Pokemon is dealt with 1/2 offensive stat; 1/2 burn damage.
abilities.long_desc: If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon takes half of the usual burn damage, rounded down.

abilities.name: Heavy Metal
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's weight is doubled.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's weight is doubled. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone.

abilities.name: Hospitality
abilities.short_desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon restores 1/4 of its ally's maximum HP, rounded down.
abilities.long_desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon restores 1/4 of its ally's maximum HP, rounded down.

abilities.name: Huge Power
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's Attack is doubled.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's Attack is doubled.

abilities.name: Hunger Switch
abilities.short_desc: If Morpeko, it changes between Full Belly and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.
abilities.long_desc: If this Pokemon is a Morpeko, it changes formes between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Hustle
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's Attack is 1.5× and accuracy of its physical attacks is 0.8×.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and the accuracy of its physical attacks is multiplied by 0.8.

abilities.name: Hydration
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon has its status cured at the end of each turn if Rain is active.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn if Rain is active. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Hyper Cutter
abilities.short_desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.
abilities.long_desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.

abilities.name: Ice Body
abilities.short_desc: If Snow is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.
abilities.long_desc: If Snow is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Illuminate
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's accuracy can't be lowered by others; ignores their evasiveness stat.
abilities.long_desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

abilities.name: Illusion
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon appears as the last Pokemon in the party until it takes direct damage.
abilities.long_desc: When this Pokemon switches in, it appears as the last unfainted Pokemon in its party until it takes direct damage from another Pokemon's attack. This Pokemon's actual level and HP are displayed instead of those of the mimicked Pokemon.

abilities.name: Immunity
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.

abilities.name: Imposter
abilities.short_desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon Transforms into the opposing Pokemon that is facing it.
abilities.long_desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon Transforms into the opposing Pokemon that is facing it. If there is no Pokemon at that position, this Pokemon does not Transform.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.short_desc: Moves ignore substitutes and foe's Reflect/Light Screen/Safeguard/Mist/Aurora Veil.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's moves ignore substitutes and the opposing side's Reflect, Light Screen, Safeguard, Mist, and Aurora Veil.

abilities.name: Innards Out
abilities.short_desc: If this Pokemon is KOed with a move, that move's user loses an equal amount of HP.
abilities.long_desc: If this Pokemon is knocked out with a move, that move's user loses HP equal to the amount of damage inflicted on this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. Immune to Intimidate.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.short_desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opponents by 1 stage.
abilities.long_desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opposing Pokemon by 1 stage. Pokemon with the Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, or Scrappy Abilities and Pokemon behind a substitute are immune.

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have 1.2× power. Sucker Punch is not boosted.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.2.

abilities.name: Justified
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a Dark-type move.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a Dark-type move.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's accuracy can't be lowered by others; ignores their evasiveness stat.
abilities.long_desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

abilities.name: Klutz
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's held item has no effect, except Macho Brace. Fling cannot be used.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's held item has no effect. This Pokemon cannot use Fling successfully. Macho Brace, Power Anklet, Power Band, Power Belt, Power Bracer, Power Lens, and Power Weight still have their effects.

abilities.name: Leaf Guard
abilities.short_desc: If Sun is active, this Pokemon cannot be statused and Rest will fail for it.
abilities.long_desc: If Sun is active, this Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn, and Rest will fail for it. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground; Gravity/Ingrain/Smack Down/Iron Ball nullify it.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability.

abilities.name: Libero
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of the move it is using. Once per switch-in.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.

abilities.name: Light Metal
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's weight is halved.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's weight is halved, rounded down to a tenth of a kilogram. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone. A Pokemon's weight will not drop below 0.1 kg.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon draws Electric moves to itself to raise Sp. Atk by 1; Electric immunity.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.

abilities.name: Limber
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.

abilities.name: Liquid Ooze
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.

abilities.name: Liquid Voice
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water type.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water-type moves. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

abilities.name: Long Reach
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's attacks do not make contact with the target.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's attacks do not make contact with the target.

abilities.name: Magic Bounce
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon blocks certain Status moves and bounces them back to the user.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or Magic Coat's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or Magic Coat's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this Ability takes effect.

abilities.name: Magic Guard
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks. Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, Struggle recoil, and confusion damage are considered direct damage.

abilities.name: Magician
abilities.short_desc: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack.
abilities.long_desc: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight. If multiple targets are hit by an attack the item is stolen from the fastest Pokemon, while considering the effect of Trick Room and prioritizing opposing Pokemon before allies.

abilities.name: Magma Armor
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.

abilities.name: Marvel Scale
abilities.short_desc: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.
abilities.long_desc: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Mega Launcher
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's pulse moves have 1.5× power. Heal Pulse heals 3/4 target's max HP.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's pulse moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. Heal Pulse restores 3/4 of a target's maximum HP, rounded half down.

abilities.name: Mega Sol
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's moves are used as if the effects of Sun were active.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's moves are used as if the effects of Sun were active.

abilities.name: Merciless
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.

abilities.name: Mimicry
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's types change to match the Terrain. Type reverts when Terrain ends.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's types change to match the active Terrain when this Pokemon acquires this Ability, or whenever a Terrain begins. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. If this Ability is acquired without an active Terrain, or a Terrain ends, this Pokemon's types become the original types for its species.

abilities.name: Minus
abilities.short_desc: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5×.
abilities.long_desc: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Mirror Armor
abilities.short_desc: If this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered, the attacker's are lowered instead.
abilities.long_desc: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered by another Pokemon, that Pokemon's stat stage is lowered instead. This effect does not happen if this Pokemon's stat stage was already -6. If the other Pokemon has a substitute, neither Pokemon has its stat stage lowered.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Moody
abilities.short_desc: Boosts a random stat (except accuracy/evasion) +2 and another stat -1 every turn.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage if hit by an Electric move; Electric immunity.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.

abilities.name: Moxie
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and KOes another Pokemon.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.

abilities.name: Multiscale
abilities.short_desc: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.
abilities.long_desc: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

abilities.name: Mummy
abilities.short_desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy.
abilities.long_desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Mummy, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.

abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.short_desc: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.
abilities.long_desc: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Immune to Intimidate.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Opportunist
abilities.short_desc: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.
abilities.long_desc: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.

abilities.name: Overcoat
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, Sandstorm damage, and Effect Spore.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, damage from Sandstorm, and the effects of Rage Powder and the Effect Spore Ability.

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.short_desc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5× with Grass attacks.
abilities.long_desc: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Immune to Intimidate.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Parental Bond
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's damaging moves hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's damaging moves become multi-hit moves that hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered. Does not affect Doom Desire, Dragon Darts, Dynamax Cannon, Endeavor, Explosion, Final Gambit, Fling, Future Sight, Ice Ball, Rollout, Self-Destruct, any multi-hit move, any move that has multiple targets, or any two-turn move.

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.short_desc: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item.
abilities.long_desc: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.short_desc: If this Pokemon has no item, it finds one used by an adjacent Pokemon this turn.
abilities.long_desc: At the end of each turn, if this Pokemon is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokemon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokemon is selected at random and this Pokemon obtains that Pokemon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokemon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up.

abilities.name: Piercing Drill
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.

abilities.name: Pixilate
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy type and have 1.2× power.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

abilities.name: Plus
abilities.short_desc: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5×.
abilities.long_desc: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

abilities.name: Poison Heal
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon is healed by 1/8 of its max HP each turn when poisoned; no HP loss.
abilities.long_desc: If this Pokemon is poisoned, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn instead of losing HP.

abilities.name: Poison Point
abilities.short_desc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.
abilities.long_desc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.

abilities.name: Poison Touch
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning. This effect comes after a move's inherent secondary effect chance.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's Status moves have priority raised by 1, but Dark types are immune.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.short_desc: If this Pokemon is the target of a foe's move, that move loses one additional PP.
abilities.long_desc: If this Pokemon is the target of an opposing Pokemon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokemon, but Sticky Web does not.

abilities.name: Protean
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's type changes to the type of the move it is using. Once per switch-in.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.

abilities.name: Psychic Surge
abilities.short_desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain.
abilities.long_desc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain.

abilities.name: Punk Rock
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon receives 1/2 damage from sound moves. Its own have 1.3× power.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's sound-based moves have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes halved damage from sound-based moves.

abilities.name: Pure Power
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's Attack is doubled.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's Attack is doubled.

abilities.name: Purifying Salt
abilities.short_desc: Ghost damage to this Pokemon dealt with a halved offensive stat; can't be statused.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. If a Pokemon uses a Ghost-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.

abilities.name: Queenly Majesty
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon and its allies are protected from opposing priority moves.
abilities.long_desc: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.

abilities.name: Quick Draw
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.

abilities.name: Quick Feet
abilities.short_desc: If this Pokemon is statused, its Speed is 1.5×; ignores Speed drop from paralysis.
abilities.long_desc: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Speed is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon ignores the paralysis effect of halving Speed.

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.short_desc: If Rain is active, this Pokemon heals 1/16 of its max HP each turn.
abilities.long_desc: If Rain is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

abilities.name: Rattled
abilities.short_desc: Speed is raised 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or Intimidated.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or if an opposing Pokemon affected this Pokemon with the Intimidate Ability.

abilities.name: Receiver
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.

abilities.name: Reckless
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have 1.2× power; not Struggle.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have their power multiplied by 1.2. Does not affect Struggle.

abilities.name: Refrigerate
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice type and have 1.2× power.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when it switches out.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when it switches out.

abilities.name: Ripen
abilities.short_desc: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled.
abilities.long_desc: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled. Berries that restore HP or PP have the amount doubled, Berries that raise stat stages have the amount doubled, Berries that halve damage taken quarter it instead, and a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry has the attacker lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

abilities.name: Rivalry
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's attacks do 1.25× on same gender targets; 0.75× on opposite gender.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon's attacks have their power multiplied by 1.25 against targets of the same gender or multiplied by 0.75 against targets of the opposite gender. There is no modifier if either this Pokemon or the target is genderless.

abilities.name: Rock Head
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage besides Struggle/Life Orb/crash damage.
abilities.long_desc: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage, except Struggle. Does not affect Life Orb damage or crash damage.

abilities.name: Rough Skin
abilities.short_desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their max HP.
abilities.long_desc: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down.

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon cannot be trapped: it ignores any effect that would prevent it from switching out.
abilities.long_desc: Champions-specific: this Pokemon ignores every effect that would usually prevent it from switching out of battle (trapping moves such as Mean Look or Block and trapping abilities such as Arena Trap or Shadow Tag). In the main-series games Run Away has no competitive use.

abilities.name: Sand Force
abilities.short_desc: This Pokemon's Ground/Rock/Steel attacks do 1.3× in Sandstorm; immunity to it.
abilities.long_desc: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Ground-, Rock-, and Steel-type attacks have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

classifications.description: Explosive move - the user faints (Explosion family). Confirmed on Explosion, Self-Destruct and Misty Explosion.
classifications.note: CHAMPIONS-NATIVE: no counterpart exists in Showdown or the Champions mod data (verified absent), so every row is owner-observed in-game. Has a real consumer in M-B: Damp (legal on 3 species) prevents explosive moves. COMPLETENESS IS DECLARED, NOT SURVEYED: the 3 confirmed moves are the entire mainline explosion family legal in M-B (Mind Blown is not legal). The open question was whether the label meant USER-FAINTS rather than explosion; Healing Wish - a legal user-faints move - was checked and came back NEGATIVE, which settles it as explosion-specific and makes Memento and Final Gambit near-certain non-members. On that evidence the owner declared the set closed. Absence now means the move is NOT Explosive.
Copycat is legal in M-B so this is live.

classifications.description: Mental move - a Classification the Champions move-detail screen displays. Confirmed on Taunt, Attract, Encore, Disable and Torment.
classifications.note: CHAMPIONS-NATIVE: no counterpart exists in Showdown or the Champions mod data (verified absent), so every row is owner-observed in-game. NO MECHANIC IS MODELLED: despite the shared name, Mental Herb keys on the resulting volatile condition (Attract/Disable/Encore/Heal Block/Taunt/Torment) and NOT on this move property, so do NOT infer that Mental Herb or any other effect reads this flag. No known M-B effect consumes it. COMPLETENESS IS DECLARED, NOT SURVEYED: the 5 confirmed moves are exactly the 5 legal Mental Herb cure-list moves. A falsification pass then checked 4 mind-affecting moves OUTSIDE that list - Confuse Ray, Swagger, Hypnosis and Charm - and all 4 came back NEGATIVE, ruling out the confusion/sleep/infatuation families. On that evidence the owner declared the set closed rather than running the full 85-species sweep. Absence therefore now means the move is NOT Mental. If a counterexample ever turns up, set membership back to partial and add it.
